en.headline: Search under way for passenger missing from Shekou sightseeing boat near HZMB
en.dek: Hong Kong marine police, fireboats and a Government Flying Service helicopter joined the search in waters west of Tuen Mun after the man was noticed missing on the return to Shenzhen.
body: Hong Kong rescue services launched a search on Tuesday afternoon for a male passenger believed to have fallen overboard from a sightseeing vessel that had travelled from Shekou in Shenzhen to view the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge.

The operator reported the incident at about 3.14 pm after crew members counted passengers on the return to Shekou and found one man missing. Review of on-board closed-circuit television led the company to suspect the passenger had gone overboard during the voyage.

Because the suspected location was near Hong Kong waters, local authorities deployed marine police, fireboats and a Government Flying Service helicopter to search the area off Tuen Mun near the Black Point Power Station and Hau Hoi Wan. Fire and ambulance crews assembled at the Tuen Mun fireboat pier before heading out.
As of early evening the search remained ongoing with no sign of the missing passenger reported. The Marine Department and other units continued to assist.

zh.headline: 港珠澳大橋觀光船疑有乘客墮海 屯門海域搜救中
zh.dek: 深圳蛇口出發的觀光船回程發現一名男乘客失蹤，香港水警、滅火輪及飛行服務隊直升機在屯門后海灣一帶搜索。
body: 一艘由深圳蛇口出發前往港珠澳大橋一帶觀光的客船，今日下午回程後發現一名男乘客失蹤，船公司翻查閉路電視後懷疑該人在航程期間墮海，於下午約3時14分報警。
由於懷疑墮海位置接近本港水域，香港救援當局接報後加入搜救。水警、消防滅火輪及政府飛行服務隊直升機在屯門后海灣近龍鼓灘發電廠一帶海面搜索，消防員及救護員亦在屯門滅火輪碼頭集合後出海。
海事處船隻亦協助海空搜救。截至傍晚仍未有發現，搜救行動繼續進行。
船公司指乘客在回程清點人數時發現失蹤，閉路電視片段顯示懷疑有人於航程中墮海。
